Eskimo Bob Starring Alfonzo.name: Eskimo Bob: Starring Alfonzo
Eskimo Bob Starring Alfonzo.summary: Eskimo Bob is an 8-bit puzzle-platformer with sixty-four levels of fish-collecting action. Originally developed for the NES, you can now enjoy this game on Steam!

RoboCop Versus The Terminator.name: RoboCop Versus the Terminator
RoboCop Versus The Terminator.summary: A cancelled NES game based on the RoboCop Versus The Terminator comic book series. The game is a side-scrolling shooter where you play as RoboCop, shooting through various Terminators and robots on your quest to destroy Skynet.
